# Expected manifest outputs for testing merge-manifest.sh

# Scenario 1: Both architectures successful
# Expected: Multi-arch manifest with 2 platforms
scenario_both_success_platforms=2
scenario_both_success_architectures="amd64,arm64"

# Scenario 2: Only amd64 successful (arm64 failed)
# Expected: Single-arch manifest with 1 platform
scenario_amd64_only_platforms=1
scenario_amd64_only_architectures="amd64"

# Scenario 3: Only arm64 successful (amd64 failed)
# Expected: Single-arch manifest with 1 platform
scenario_arm64_only_platforms=1
scenario_arm64_only_architectures="arm64"

# Scenario 4: Both architectures failed
# Expected: Script exits with error code 2
scenario_both_failed_exit_code=2

# Scenario 5: Missing digest parameters
# Expected: Script exits with error code 1
scenario_missing_params_exit_code=1
